chunks: And ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Ribā only applies to what is measured or weighed.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, the Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury; unlawful increase in exchange transactions
key_terms.يُكَالُ: that which is measured by volume or measure
key_terms.يُوزَنُ: that which is measured by weight

ai.seo_question: To which types of goods does ribā apply in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle that ribā applies in items that are transacted by measure or weight. It is a concise fiqh ruling that defines the scope of usury in commercial exchange.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3996 - Ubayd ibn Zurarah narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) who said: "
Usury only applies to what is measured or weighed."
